intro.title: Accidentals
intro.text: A sharp, flat or natural written in the music (not in the key signature) is an accidental. It lasts until the end of its bar.

intro.title: Naturals
intro.text: A natural (♮) cancels a sharp or flat: play the white key. In bar 2, the F♯ is followed by an F natural in the same bar.
